_about: Walter Leaf (1852-1927): Troy, a Study in Homeric Geography (London: Macmillan, 1912) and Homer and History (Macmillan, 1915), raw IA OCR. His Iliad with Lang and Myers (PG 3059) is on the lang shelf. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. A Companion to the Iliad for English Readers (1892), a book-by-book commentary keyed to the Lang-Leaf-Myers prose translation; and his Iliad, edited with apparatus criticus, prolegomena, notes and appendices, second edition (Macmillan, 2 vols., 1900-1902), Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling; all raw IA. Round dy (2026-10-23), raw IA: The Story of Achilles with J. H. Pratt (second edition, 1882), the Elementary Classics Iliad VI with M. A. Bayfield (1899 reprint of 1893), his verse translations Quatrains from the Greek (1919, privately printed) and Little Poems from the Greek (1922, versions of epigrams from the Greek Anthology), and the paper Skepsis in the Troad (1923). Not taken: Versions from Hafiz (1898, Persian) and Banking (1926, outside the classical brief).
